title.rendered: Tutorial: Monitoring Application and Network Latency with nProbe

content.rendered: Last May I did a tutorial at the Nagios Conference Europe about application and network latency measurement using nProbe. The video of the tutorial has been now released and you are free to watch it if interested in he topic. The video is available here.
